# Continuation handoff

Date/time: UTC. Audience/next-session focus: explicit.

## Goal and state

Project/task IDs and effective revisions; current milestone and blocked gates.

## Reading order

Canonical vision, pilot, ADRs, contracts, repository roles, and exact source revisions.

## Evidence and decisions

Final tested SHA/environment; checks performed versus not performed; operator decision; integration/deployment receipts if any.

## Context and privacy

Selected manifest/digest and approved source references; excluded sensitive material stays excluded.

## Open work and next authorized action

Custody owner/native IDs, pending or unknown intents, blockers, bounded next task, and authority limits.

## Suggested skills

Call the harness's skill-loading tool for relevant skills actually available: Cloudflare; Workers best practices; Wrangler before CLI operations; systematic debugging for failures; planning/execution for ratified tasks; verification before claims. Inspect actual memory-system skills when identified. Use handoff if installed; otherwise follow the operator's provided handoff instructions.

Do not copy existing specs/manuals; link them. Never include credentials or personal identifiers.
